description: This file defines a stateless worker grain class in an Orleans project, implementing a streaming consumer with subscription logic.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerStreamConsumerGrain
classes.description: A stateless worker grain class that consumes stream items, logs activity, and manages stream subscriptions.

methods.name: OnCompletedAsync
methods.description: Handles stream completion; currently completes immediately.

methods.name: OnErrorAsync
methods.description: Handles stream errors; currently completes immediately.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Processes incoming stream items; currently completes immediately.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Subscribes the grain to a stream given its ID and provider, setting up handlers for stream events.
